qualification_scope: typed normal-mode ChangeVanguard=ship_equip empty-source production boundary with reversible five-slot fixture

reversible_fixture.statement: The production typed take-off port captured and unloaded Napoli's five regular slots. The retained exact loadout was held only for cleanup; the production ship_equip boundary then independently captured an empty source loadout.

operations: production gems_farming_equipment_take_off(vanguard) captured an empty prepared source
production CommonDD=any admission returned exactly one eligible Spence
production select and confirm proved Spence in vanguard_1
production gems_farming_equipment_take_on(vanguard) proved the empty target loadout and cleared the pending transfer

recovery.napoli_lookup: bounded typed Dock virtual-list traversal with exact ship_id=699024 and sprite=nabulesi
recovery.first_mount_attempt: slots 1-4 mounted; slot 5 stopped fail-closed because 2400 +10 was not visible in that bounded inventory traversal
recovery.retry: the same retained five-slot loadout was re-injected after returning through the reviewed equipment back path; only the missing slot required mounting

supervision.statement: After the production target postcondition, the first host process stopped issuing input while cleanup had not started. It was terminated before a separate recovery session was opened; no concurrent input chains were used.

statement: This receipt promotes only the empty-source ChangeVanguard=ship_equip value to live-partial support. It does not claim that Napoli's cruiser-class five-slot loadout can be mounted on Spence or that arbitrary non-empty vanguard transfers are compatible.
